sloka: नैकस्य हेतो रक्षांसि पृथिव्यां हन्तु मर्हसि।अयुध्यमानं प्रच्छन्नं प्राञ्जलिं शरणागतम्।पलायन्तं प्रमत्तं वा न त्वं हन्तुमिहार्हसि ।। ६.८०.३९ ।।
transliteration: naikasya heto rakṣāṁsi pṛthivyāṁ hantu marhasi।ayudhyamānaṁ pracchannaṁ prāñjaliṁ śaraṇāgatam।palāyantaṁ pramattaṁ vā na tvaṁ hantumihārhasi ।। 6.80.39 ।।

translations.english: "You should not kill anyone who is not waging war, not fighting and hidden, one with folded palms surrendered, one who runs away from war and not alert in war"
